mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_api_endpoint_stat ( endpoint_key, http_method, path_pattern, module_code, total_calls, encrypted_calls, plaintext_calls, rejected_calls, error_calls, total_duration_ms, p95_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, last_called_at_ms ) VALUES ( #{endpointKey}, #{httpMethod}, #{pathPattern}, #{moduleCode}, #{totalDelta}, #{encDelta}, #{plainDelta}, #{rejDelta}, #{errDelta}, #{durDelta}, #{p95Ms}, #{p99Ms}, #{lastCalledAtMs} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_calls = total_calls + VALUES(total_calls), encrypted_calls = encrypted_calls + VALUES(encrypted_calls), plaintext_calls = plaintext_calls + VALUES(plaintext_calls), rejected_calls = rejected_calls + VALUES(rejected_calls), error_calls = error_calls + VALUES(error_calls), total_duration_ms = total_duration_ms + VALUES(total_duration_ms), p95_latency_ms = IF(VALUES(p95_latency_ms) > 0, VALUES(p95_latency_ms), p95_latency_ms), p99_latency_ms = IF(VALUES(p99_latency_ms) > 0, VALUES(p99_latency_ms), p99_latency_ms), last_called_at_ms = GREATEST(last_called_at_ms, VALUES(last_called_at_ms))
